mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost of new window installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of new window installation varies widely based on the window type, material, size, number of windows, and complexity of the installation. Factors like energy-efficient glazing, custom shapes, and frame materials (e.g., vinyl versus wood) all influence the final price. We provide detailed, no-obligation estimates after a site visit to accurately assess your project's scope.
